title: Smoky Lentil Shepherd's Pie
description: A hearty, deeply savoury lentil filling topped with crisp-edged mashed potatoes for a comforting vegan dinner.

method.title: Cook lentils and potatoes
method.description: Simmer the lentils in 500 ml vegetable stock for 25-30 minutes until tender but not collapsing. In a separate pan, boil potatoes until soft, drain well, then mash with 1 tbsp olive oil and a splash of hot water until smooth.

method.title: Build the savoury base
method.description: Heat remaining olive oil in a deep pan, then cook onion, carrot, and celery for 8-10 minutes until sweet and lightly golden. Add garlic, smoked paprika, and thyme; cook for 1 minute to bloom the spices.

method.title: Reduce the filling
method.description: Stir in tomato puree, then add cooked lentils, remaining stock, and peas. Simmer until thick and spoonable, reducing any excess liquid so the pie slices cleanly.

method.title: Assemble and bake
method.description: Spread filling into a baking dish, top with mashed potato, rough up the surface with a fork for crispy peaks, and bake at 200C for 20-25 minutes until deeply golden.

title: Creamy Coconut Chickpea Curry
description: A rich, aromatic chickpea curry with spinach and tomatoes, finished with coconut milk for a balanced weeknight vegan curry.

method.title: Start the rice
method.description: Cook the basmati rice according to packet instructions so it is ready when the curry finishes.

method.title: Build flavour base
method.description: Heat olive oil in a deep pan and cook onion for 6-8 minutes until soft and lightly golden. Add garlic, ginger, curry powder, and cumin, cooking for 1 minute to toast the spices.

method.title: Simmer the curry
method.description: Add chopped tomatoes, coconut milk, and chickpeas. Simmer for 12-15 minutes until the sauce thickens and tastes rounded; reduce a little further for a richer finish.

method.title: Finish and serve
method.description: Stir in spinach until wilted, then squeeze in lime juice to balance the richness. Serve over rice.

title: Sticky Tofu and Broccoli Sesame Traybake
description: Crisp tofu and charred broccoli roasted in a sticky sesame soy glaze for a low-effort, high-flavour vegan dinner.

method.title: Prep tofu and tray
method.description: Pat tofu dry thoroughly, then toss with cornflour and half the sesame oil. Spread on a tray with broccoli and red onion.

method.title: Roast for colour
method.description: Roast at 220C for 20-25 minutes, turning once, until tofu is crisp at the edges and broccoli is charred in spots.

method.title: Make sticky glaze
method.description: Whisk soy sauce, rice vinegar, maple syrup, garlic, ginger, and remaining sesame oil in a small pan. Simmer briefly until glossy and slightly thickened.

method.title: Cook noodles and finish
method.description: Cook rice noodles according to packet instructions. Toss roasted tofu and vegetables in the glaze, scatter sesame seeds, and serve over noodles.

title: Harissa Cauliflower and Butter Bean Traybake
description: Roasted cauliflower and butter beans with warming harissa, sweet peppers, and lemony herbs for a bold vegan one-pan dinner.

method.title: Season the traybake
method.description: Toss cauliflower, peppers, onion, and butter beans with olive oil, harissa, cumin, paprika, and lemon zest. Spread evenly in a large roasting tray.

method.title: Roast until caramelised
method.description: Roast at 210C for 30-35 minutes, turning halfway. Let edges darken slightly to build depth and sweetness.

method.title: Prepare couscous
method.description: Place couscous in a bowl, pour over boiling water to just cover, then cover and steam for 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork.

method.title: Finish and serve
method.description: Squeeze lemon juice over the tray, fold through parsley, and serve over couscous.

title: Mushroom and Walnut Ragu with Spaghetti
description: A rich vegan ragu with finely chopped mushrooms and walnuts for meaty texture, served with spaghetti.

method.title: Cook soffritto base
method.description: Heat olive oil and cook onion, carrot, and celery for 8-10 minutes until soft and lightly sweet. Add garlic and oregano for 1 minute.

method.title: Brown mushrooms and walnuts
method.description: Add mushrooms and cook on medium-high heat until their moisture evaporates and they begin to brown; this concentrates flavour. Stir in walnuts and toast briefly.

method.title: Simmer ragu
method.description: Add tomato puree, chopped tomatoes, and stock. Simmer 15-20 minutes until thick and rich, stirring occasionally.

method.title: Boil pasta and combine
method.description: Cook spaghetti until al dente, reserving a little pasta water. Toss with ragu, loosening with reserved water if needed for a silky finish.

title: Black Bean and Sweet Potato Enchilada Skillet
description: A one-pan vegan enchilada-style bake with smoky black beans, sweet potato, and tortillas layered in a rich tomato sauce.

method.title: Soften sweet potato
method.description: Heat olive oil in an oven-safe pan and cook sweet potato for 8-10 minutes, stirring often, until starting to soften and colour.

method.title: Build the sauce
method.description: Add onion and cook 5 minutes, then stir in garlic, cumin, paprika, and oregano for 1 minute. Add tomato puree, chopped tomatoes, and black beans, then simmer until thick.

method.title: Layer tortillas
method.description: Fold sliced tortillas through the sauce so they soften and absorb flavour. If the mix is very thick, add a splash of water to keep it saucy.

method.title: Bake and finish
method.description: Bake at 200C for 12-15 minutes until bubbling and slightly crisp on top. Finish with chopped coriander.

title: Peanut Tofu Noodle Stir-Fry
description: Crispy tofu and vegetables tossed with rice noodles in a punchy peanut-lime sauce.

method.title: Cook noodles and prep sauce
method.description: Cook rice noodles according to packet instructions, then rinse briefly and set aside. Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice, chilli flakes, and a splash of hot water into a pourable sauce.

method.title: Crisp the tofu
method.description: Heat sesame oil in a large wok and fry tofu until crisp on multiple sides. Cook in batches if needed to avoid steaming.

method.title: Stir-fry aromatics and veg
method.description: Add garlic, ginger, carrot, and pepper to the wok, stir-frying over high heat for 3-4 minutes so vegetables stay vibrant and retain bite.

method.title: Combine and glaze
method.description: Add noodles, tofu, and peanut sauce, tossing until everything is glossy and hot. Fold through spring onion just before serving.

title: Aubergine and Chickpea Tagine with Herby Couscous
description: Soft aubergine and chickpeas simmered with warming spices and tomatoes, served over fluffy herby couscous.

method.title: Brown aubergine well
method.description: Heat olive oil in a wide pan and cook aubergine until deeply golden on multiple sides; good browning prevents a watery finish.

method.title: Build tagine base
method.description: Add onion and cook until softened, then add garlic and spices for 1 minute. Stir in chopped tomatoes, stock, and chickpeas.

method.title: Simmer for depth
method.description: Cook uncovered for 18-20 minutes until aubergine is silky and sauce has reduced to a rich stew-like consistency.

method.title: Prepare couscous and serve
method.description: Steam couscous with boiling water for 5 minutes, fluff, then fold through parsley. Spoon tagine over couscous.

title: Gochujang Tempeh Rice Bowls
description: Crispy tempeh coated in a spicy-sweet gochujang glaze with quick cucumber and steamed rice.

method.title: Cook rice and pickle cucumber
method.description: Cook rice according to packet instructions. Toss cucumber with 1 tbsp rice vinegar and a pinch of salt, then set aside to lightly pickle.

method.title: Crisp the tempeh
method.description: Steam tempeh for 5 minutes first if you prefer a milder taste, then pat dry. Fry in sesame oil until golden and crisp on the edges.

method.title: Make glaze
method.description: Mix gochujang, soy sauce, maple syrup, remaining rice vinegar, garlic, and ginger. Add to the pan and cook until it clings to the tempeh.

method.title: Assemble bowls
method.description: Serve glazed tempeh over rice with pickled cucumber, spring onion, and sesame seeds.

title: Lemon White Bean and Spinach Risotto
description: Creamy vegan risotto with white beans, spinach, and lemon for brightness and balance.

method.title: Start aromatics
method.description: Warm stock in a separate pan. In a wide pot, cook onion in olive oil for 6-8 minutes until soft, then add garlic for 1 minute.

method.title: Toast rice and add stock gradually
method.description: Stir in rice and cook 1-2 minutes until edges look translucent. Add warm stock a ladle at a time, stirring often and allowing each addition to absorb before the next.

method.title: Finish for creaminess
method.description: After about 20 minutes, stir in beans, nutritional yeast, lemon zest, and spinach. Cook until rice is tender with a slight bite and the texture is loose and creamy.

method.title: Serve
method.description: Fold through parsley and a squeeze of lemon juice just before serving for freshness.

title: Spinach and Ricotta Stuffed Shell Pasta Bake
description: Tender pasta shells filled with lemony spinach ricotta, baked in tomato sauce until bubbling and golden.

method.title: Cook shells and sauce
method.description: Boil pasta shells until just under al dente, then drain. Meanwhile, simmer chopped tomatoes with tomato puree, half the garlic, and olive oil for 10 minutes.

method.title: Make filling
method.description: Mix ricotta, spinach, lemon zest, remaining garlic, half the parmesan, and half the mozzarella until well combined.

method.title: Fill and assemble
method.description: Spread tomato sauce in a baking dish. Fill each shell with ricotta mixture and nestle into the sauce.

method.title: Bake
method.description: Top with remaining mozzarella and parmesan. Bake at 200C for 20 minutes until bubbling and lightly browned, then finish with basil.

title: Paneer Tikka Pepper Traybake
description: Oven-charred paneer and peppers in a spiced yogurt marinade, served with fragrant basmati rice.

method.title: Marinate paneer and veg
method.description: Mix yogurt, garlic, ginger, garam masala, cumin, paprika, and olive oil. Toss paneer, peppers, and onion in the marinade and leave for 10 minutes if time allows.

method.title: Roast for char
method.description: Spread on a lined tray and roast at 220C for 20-25 minutes, turning once, until paneer edges are golden and vegetables are lightly charred.

method.title: Cook rice
method.description: While the traybake roasts, cook basmati rice according to packet instructions.

method.title: Serve
method.description: Serve paneer tikka and roasted vegetables over rice, spooning over tray juices for extra flavour.

title: Halloumi and Chickpea Shawarma Bowls
description: Crisp halloumi, spiced chickpeas, and fluffy rice with a bright lemon-yogurt drizzle.

method.title: Cook rice and season chickpeas
method.description: Cook rice according to packet instructions. Toss chickpeas with cumin, smoked paprika, and half the olive oil.

method.title: Crisp halloumi and chickpeas
method.description: Fry halloumi slices in a hot pan until golden on both sides. In the same pan, cook spiced chickpeas for 4-5 minutes until lightly crisp.

method.title: Prepare bowl elements
method.description: Mix yogurt with lemon zest and juice for a sharp drizzle. Combine cucumber, tomato, red onion, and parsley for a fresh salad.

method.title: Assemble
method.description: Build bowls with rice, salad, chickpeas, and halloumi, then spoon over lemon yogurt.

title: Broccoli Cheddar Potato Frittata
description: A filling oven-finished frittata with tender potatoes, broccoli, and mature cheddar for a fast vegetarian dinner.

method.title: Cook potatoes and broccoli
method.description: Boil potatoes for 8 minutes until almost tender, adding broccoli for the final 2 minutes. Drain well to avoid a watery frittata.

method.title: Start in pan
method.description: Cook onion in olive oil in an ovenproof pan until soft and lightly golden. Add potatoes and broccoli to warm through.

method.title: Add egg mixture
method.description: Whisk eggs, milk, and most of the cheddar, then pour into the pan. Cook over low heat for 3-4 minutes until edges set.

method.title: Finish under heat
method.description: Scatter remaining cheddar on top and bake at 200C for 10-12 minutes until set in the centre. Rest 5 minutes before slicing; finish with chives.

title: Mushroom and Leek Dijon Pasta Bake
description: Creamy vegetarian pasta bake with caramelised mushrooms, sweet leeks, and a Dijon kick.

method.title: Cook pasta
method.description: Boil pasta until just under al dente, then drain, reserving a little cooking water.

method.title: Build flavourful base
method.description: Cook mushrooms in olive oil on medium-high heat until browned and concentrated. Add leek and cook until soft, then stir in garlic.

method.title: Make creamy sauce
method.description: Stir in stock, creme fraiche, and Dijon mustard, then simmer briefly. Add cheddar and half the parmesan until melted.

method.title: Bake
method.description: Combine sauce with pasta, loosening with reserved pasta water if needed. Transfer to a baking dish, top with remaining parmesan, and bake at 200C for 15 minutes until bubbling and golden.

title: Sweetcorn and Black Bean Quesadillas
description: Golden vegetarian quesadillas filled with black beans, sweetcorn, and melted cheddar, served with a cooling lime yogurt.

method.title: Make filling
method.description: Mix black beans, sweetcorn, onion, pepper, smoked paprika, cumin, and half the cheddar. Lightly mash some beans so the filling holds together.

method.title: Assemble quesadillas
method.description: Spread filling over half the tortillas, top with remaining cheddar, then cap with remaining tortillas.

method.title: Cook until crisp
method.description: Cook in a lightly oiled pan over medium heat for 2-3 minutes per side until golden and cheese is fully melted.

method.title: Serve
method.description: Mix yogurt with lime juice and serve alongside warm quesadillas with coriander scattered on top.
